declared_representation_relocations.justification: V2 stored the permutation design as one prose string; V4 keeps that exact string as permutation.definition AND freezes the same four facts as typed fields. Values are unchanged (sign-flip / hourly trade returns / 10000 / 20260911).
V4 gives PIT eligibility a first-class structured home. The original V2 location is retained verbatim, so no information moves or changes.
Same robustness rules (halves/thirds/walk-forward) grouped with the other gates.

v2.window: 30d trailing, center=median, scale=1.4826*MAD, min 336 valid historical observations

semantic_fields.v2: Significant new position-stock expansion confirms the immediately preceding price direction and predicts continuation in the next completed hour. Primary qualifying condition is OI expansion ONLY: delta_oi > 0 AND robust_z_oi >= +1.0; OI contraction or MAD-zero hours yield NO_TRADE. This explicitly prevents OI contraction (even with z >= 1 due to negative rolling median) from qualifying as expansion.
semantic_fields.v4: Significant new position-stock expansion confirms the immediately preceding price direction and predicts continuation in the next completed hour. Primary qualifying condition is OI expansion ONLY: delta_oi > 0 AND robust_z_oi >= +1.0; OI contraction or MAD-zero hours yield NO_TRADE. This explicitly prevents OI contraction (even with z >= 1 due to negative rolling median) from qualifying as expansion.

semantic_fields.v2: strictly causal (data_time <= T): completed 1h price bar exists; CURRENT_HOUR_OI_COMPLETENESS = exactly 12 distinct 5m OI snapshots in the completed hour; previous-hour reference complete; rolling feature history >= 336 valid hourly OI changes; last observation not stale (<= 600s); no conflicting duplicate <= T. No final UTC-day validity; no observations > T. A gap strictly AFTER T must not alter eligibility or feature/signal state at T (adversarially tested in PIT_CAUSALITY_V2_REPORT).
semantic_fields.v4: strictly causal (data_time <= T): completed 1h price bar exists; CURRENT_HOUR_OI_COMPLETENESS = exactly 12 distinct 5m OI snapshots in the completed hour; previous-hour reference complete; rolling feature history >= 336 valid hourly OI changes; last observation not stale (<= 600s); no conflicting duplicate <= T. No final UTC-day validity; no observations > T. A gap strictly AFTER T must not alter eligibility or feature/signal state at T (adversarially tested in PIT_CAUSALITY_V2_REPORT).

v2.contraction_condition: NO_TRADE: OI contraction hours (delta_oi <= 0) produce NO_TRADE regardless of z (a contraction-reversal variant would be a separate preregistered experiment)
v2.example_repaired: median=-10, MAD=1, delta_oi=-8 => z=1.349 BUT delta_oi<0 => NO_TRADE (previously would have fired; now blocked)
v2.expansion_condition_detail: qualifying expansion requires BOTH raw OI expansion (current delta_oi > 0, base-asset units) AND robust_z_oi >= 1.0; positive z alone with delta_oi <= 0 is NOT qualifying (contraction never qualifies even if z >= 1 due to negative median/MAD). If MAD == 0 => NO_TRADE (H6 V2 raw-sign rule, EXT-CONS-004 repair).
v2.neutral_or_insufficient: delta_oi <= 0, or z_oi < +1.0, or MAD == 0, or < 336 historical observations => NO_TRADE/NO_SIGNAL
v2.note: thresholds frozen BEFORE any performance observation; NO parameter sweep is permitted; changing these values after any economic execution invalidates the experiment
